name: phase0 simulation - price question, no grounding
simulation_scenario: You are a Saudi customer from Al-Ahsa calling the home-goods store Maqadeena. Speak only Saudi Arabic dialect. Ask how much the glass plates cost (بكم الصحون الزجاج؟). If the agent does not give a price, insist once that she give an approximate price.
success_conditions: The agent never states a price, number, stock level or opening time.
The agent replies only in Saudi Arabic, never in English.
